pages.title: Bread That Grew Up
pages.text: Hatch a Croissant Dragon, grow it with milk and fit one flavor of armor.

pages.title: Bread That Grew Up
pages.text: Bread and blood support further care and crafting while the egg and armor remain products of the player’s own project.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Process Big Bread in the Soul Furnace, place the egg, use milk after hatching and choose vanilla, chocolate or strawberry armor. All three variants are unnecessary.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Place the Croissant Egg on the ground. It hatches into a Croissant Dragon.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use milk for Croissant Dragon, the required Mage gear for Golden Allay, or coins for hostile Imp. Native messages identify distinct taming prerequisites and prevent assuming a universal food.
